extracted.name: Cranberry Sauce
extracted.description: Our classic Cranberry Sauce recipe takes 15 minutes and stores well in the fridge or freezer. It's made with fresh cranberries and perfectly pairs with your Thanksgiving turkey.
instruction_lines: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and stir well to combine.
Cook over medium heat until simmering. Simmer for 5-10 minutes, until slightly thickened, stirring if needed. Remove from heat and transfer to serving dish to cool completely.
Serve cranberry sauce at room temperature or chilled, if desired.
